verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says n8n keeps historical executions and shows the data going in and out of each component, and the vendor says every agent reasoning step is traceable on the canvas. Per-step input/output inspection is therefore evidenced. Nothing in the pack covers pinning or mocking sample data, or a test-run mode before activation. missing for 10: pinned/sample data support, documented test or manual execution before going live, first-party docs on per-node input/output inspection.
